response.what_it_is: MacBook Pro 2020 13-inch topcase assembly with keyboard, trackpad, and battery
hidden_risks: Functional status of individual keys, trackpad, and backlighting
Battery health, cycle count, and whether cells are swollen or degraded
Presence of water damage or corrosion on flex cables and internal boards
seller_claims_unsupported: Functional condition of internal components like the battery and keyboard
response.failure_mode: Mistaking the topcase assembly for a fully working laptop or assuming the stripped components are fully functional without testing.
